name: opencode-usage
description: Typed subscription usage, telemetry, and quota-aware routing APIs
about: Tells you what your subscriptions have left. It reads the accounts your host already uses and reports observed quota windows, burn rate, forecast to a deadline, per-session history and token/cost telemetry through the usage_status, usage_experience, usage_pacing and usage_target tools, a usage CLI and a stdio MCP server. It starts no background collector.
needs: the provider accounts and their local sign-in or auth files
